query: A Note on Fitting a Regression Without an Intercept Term

record.title: A Note on Fitting a Regression without an Intercept Term
record.abstract: By entering the data (y i ,x i ) followed by (–y i ,–x i ), one can obtain an intercept-free regression Y = Xβ + ε from a program package that normally uses an intercept term. There is no bias in the resultant regression coefficients, but a minor postanalysis adjustment is needed to the residual variance and standard errors.
